caveats:
The product contains modified Copernicus Sentinel data (2023-2024), processed by ESA and analyzed by the Earth Observatory of Singapore - Remote Sensing Lab (EOS-RS).

These are preliminary maps derived from satellite radar and should be used as guidance only. Coloured pixels may include false positives, and their absence does not mean an absence of damage or flooding.
methodology_other: Change detection on synthetic aperture radar (SAR) satellite images acquired before and after the event. Damage Proxy Maps show significant changes in radar coherence and amplitude; Flood Proxy Maps show areas that changed to standing water. Maps are preliminary and checked against news reports and ground-level imagery where available.

# Indonesia Volcano Eruption: Damage Proxy Maps, Apr 2024

The **Earth Observatory of Singapore – Remote Sensing Lab (EOS-RS)** produced these damage proxy maps for Indonesia Volcano Eruption (Apr 2024) from synthetic aperture radar (SAR) satellite images. Each map is a separate ZIP below with its GeoTIFF, a KMZ for Google Earth, the PNG figures and a text file describing how it was made and how to read it.

## Maps in this dataset

- **EOS-RS Damage Proxy Map: Indonesia, Volcano Eruption, 26 Apr 2024 wbd** (superseded)
- **EOS-RS Damage Proxy Map: Indonesia, Volcano Eruption, 26 Apr 2024 wbd** (superseded)
- **EOS-RS Damage Proxy Map: Indonesia, Volcano Eruption, 26 Apr 2024**

organization.description: The Earth Observatory of Singapore - Remote Sensing Lab (EOS-RS) is a research lab at Nanyang Technological University (NTU), Singapore. It uses satellite remote sensing, mainly synthetic aperture radar (SAR), to map natural hazards and disasters. The lab produces Damage Proxy Maps (DPMs) and Flood Proxy Maps (FPMs) showing where damage or flooding has likely occurred. Its work focuses on Southeast Asia and the wider Asia-Pacific, and it also responds to major disasters worldwide.

resources.description:
EOS-RS Damage Proxy Map: Indonesia, Volcano Eruption, 26 Apr 2024 wbd

ZIP containing: GeoTIFF, KMZ, PNG, TXT.

Superseded by a later version in this dataset.

The Earth Observatory of Singapore - Remote Sensing Lab (EOS-RS) created this preliminary Damage Proxy Map (DPM) depicting areas that are likely damaged in Indonesia due to the eruption of Mount Ruang on 17 Apr 2024. This map was derived from synthetic aperture radar (SAR) images acquired by the Copernicus Sentinel-1 satellite operated by the European Space Agency (ESA) before (28 Dec 2023 and 14 Apr 2024) and after (26 Apr 2024) the event.
